1945, December 13
The following is a faithful transcription of a handwritten message on a Christmas card by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
(to Mr. and Mrs. Joseph O"Donnell)
after the Printed Christmas Greeting Fr. Solanus wrote:
In short a joyful Blessed Christmas and success spiritually and temprarely the follow- ing year -- years.
Fraternally in Christo Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
P. S. The fruit is excellent -- really worth while - - Two big bushels God bless all.
(following written on another card which had a St. Christ- opher medal attached:)
Feast of Purification '45
God bless and protect all who follow the inclosed St. Christopher --- just blessed.
God bless all the O"Donnells
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. C.
